The '''Victory Rationing Orders and Regulation Plan''' was an initiative that was instigated by the [[Galactic Republic General Ministry]] following the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], to preserve supplies of materiel for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] war effort and to hold back inflation of the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credit standard]]. However, the VORP lead to a rise in the counterfeiting of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] fuel authorization markers, and in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Republic Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Republic Office of Criminal Investigations]] assigned the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] to crack down on ration fraud and enforce the plan.
